quarterly_data.quarter: Coherent press release: Coherent Begins Customer Sampling of 300mm High Thermal (08-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Coherent has begun sampling its 300mm high thermal conductivity silicon carbide (SiC) substrates to leading AI semiconductor partners (not named), moving the 300mm SiC platform from internal development to customer evaluation. The substrates target next-generation heat spreaders and related packaging for AI and HPC processors and are engineered to improve heat spreading by up to 25% more than current solutions while staying compatible with existing semiconductor manufacturing; Coherent is vertically integrated in SiC crystal growth, wafering and polishing and cites progression toward future high-volume manufacturing.
quarterly_data.figure: 300mm SiC substrates sampling; heat spreading improved by up to 25%
